limitations: Remote retrieval, scientific oracle/certificate validity, and process behavior are preserved reports rather than newly reproduced observations.
17 qualified outcomes include six expected rejection outcomes; only 11 scenes have certified loads and tolerance decisions.
The two stress scenes remain unqualified and fullQualification is false.
Error upper values are certified bounds, not measured physical errors; this audit does not recompute their scientific validity.
Sampled RSS and supervision wall time are operational records, not hard instantaneous memory bounds or throughput evidence.
